jobs.occupation: Specialist Doctors in General Practice Wanted for Region Dalarna, Sweden
jobs.description:
Region Dalarna is looking for dedicated and skilled Specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine Physicians to join our Primary Care Centres across Dalarna.

This is an opportunity to work in a well-developed public healthcare system where continuity of care, preventive medicine and long-term patient relationships are highly valued. As a family physician, you will play a central role in providing comprehensive care for patients of all ages while collaborating closely with nurses, physiotherapists, psychologists and other healthcare professionals.

Why Choose Dalarna?
Dalarna is one of Sweden's most picturesque regions, located in the heart of Sweden with approximately 300,000 inhabitants. Here, you'll find a unique combination of professional opportunities, beautiful nature and a high quality of life.
Dalarna is known for its lakes, forests and mountains, offering excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year. Stockholm and Arlanda Airport can be reached easily, making both domestic and international travel convenient.
For more information about life in Dalarna, please visit https://www.visitdalarna.se/en

About Region Dalarna
Region Dalarna is the largest employer in the region with more than 8,500 employees and four hospitals in Avesta, Falun, Ludvika and Mora, as well as a large network of primary care centres.
Primary care is the foundation of Swedish healthcare, and our health centres offer modern facilities, multidisciplinary teamwork and excellent opportunities for professional development.

We Are Looking For
Specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine
Family Physicians interested in long-term careers in Sweden

Candidate Profile
To be considered for this role, you should:
Be a licensed specialist doctor in General Practice within the EU/EEA
Hold EU/EEA citizenship
Have a minimum of 5 years of relevant clinical experience
Possess English language skills at CEFR B2 level
Have strong communication and collaboration skills
Be committed to high-quality, patient-centred care

We Offer
A 22-week intensive Swedish language programme, starting in either February or August each year. Participants receive an educational salary while studying Swedish towards C1 level, a requirement for obtaining Swedish medical licensure.
A modern and supportive working environment
Continuing professional development opportunities
At least 25 days of paid vacation per year
A permanent contract, conditioned with at least 2 years of service in Region Dalarna
Support with moving costs via EURES/TMS, https://arbetsformedlingen.se/other-languages/english-engelska/eures-targeted-mobility-scheme-tms-sweden/for-jobseekers
Assistance for partners/spouses in finding work opportunities in Dalarna

jobs.occupation: Accountant to Northern Offshore Services
jobs.description:

We are looking for a structured and analytical Accountant with a strong business mindset and an eye for detail. You enjoy taking ownership of your work, meeting deadlines and finding practical solutions.
As a person, you are positive, communicative and enjoy working with others. You thrive in a changing environment and appreciate being part of a team where colleagues support each other and share knowledge.

A relevant degree in accounting, finance or equivalent.
At least three years of experience in accounting.
Solid knowledge of monthly closing, reconciliations and financial reporting.
A structured, accurate and solution-oriented approach.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Fluency in English and at least one Scandinavian language, preferably Swedish.

As an Accountant, you will be an important part of our Finance team, contributing to accurate financial reporting and the continued development of our financial processes.

Ensure timely and accurate monthly closing in accordance with internal and external requirements.
Perform intercompany and balance sheet reconciliations.

Identify and implement improvements to accounting processes.

At N-O-S, you will be part of an international organisation with strong maritime expertise, an entrepreneurial spirit and a clear ambition to lead the development of the offshore wind industry.
We offer a positive and collaborative working environment where you will have the opportunity to take responsibility, develop your skills and contribute to how we work going forward.
Our vision, BEST365, and our values are at the heart of our company culture, guiding how we work together and deliver for our customers every day of the year.

jobs.occupation: Computer vision specialist
jobs.description:
Join our team and help shape the future of technology by contributing to cutting-edge products and platforms.
About us
Synteda AB specializes in helping companies effectively embrace the era of artificial intelligence and computer vision. By delivering innovative solutions, we empower businesses to take full advantage of the vast possibilities presented by these cutting-edge technologies. We firmly believe in the potential of AI and computer vision to benefit society, and we’re committed to leveraging our expertise to facilitate businesses in their journey towards this exciting new era. Our close collaboration with top universities in Sweden enables us to work with clients across a broad range of industry fields.
We’re actively engaged in developing several unique products and solutions, using a work process that we call “dream-innovate-create.” This approach involves subjecting our ideas to rigorous scrutiny and feasibility testing, using agile methodologies to refine our solutions until we’ve achieved a full-scale product.
We’re proud to have a core team of highly qualified experts who excel at providing assessment services to identify business challenges and develop customized algorithms to overcome them. We’re guided by our commitment to ethical awareness, curiosity, transparency, respect, participation and science.
What are we looking for?
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Computer Vision Specialist to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing state-of-the-art computer vision solutions that will drive innovation and growth in our organization.
Responsibilities
Design and implement algorithms for innovative products and platforms.
Develop advanced computer vision and AI techniques.
Design, implement, and optimize AI algorithms.
Innovate and enforce intellectual property rights (IPR) protection.
Validate, analyze, and evaluate models.
Perform research, analysis, and modeling on data.
Train, validate, and test algorithms.
Collaborate with cross-functional team members.

Required skills
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Programming experience in a combination of Python, C#, C/C++, Spark, Java/Scala.
Knowledge of scientific computing languages such as MATLAB or R.
Solid experience with data analytics, predictive, and prescriptive data.
Familiarity with frameworks like PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and others.
Hands-on experience with computer vision algorithms.
Experience with OpenCV and other computer vision libraries.
Experience working with depth sensors.
Strong knowledge of analytics and image processing.
Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
Fluency in English, both spoken and written, is required.
Proficiency in Swedish is a plus.

Collaborate with your fellow game makers

 We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind

jobs.occupation: CNC Operator with an Interest in Programming and Precision Machining
jobs.description:
We are committed to shaping the green industry of the future. We are proud to contribute to the development of the region and to creating a brighter, greener future.
About Nova Industri
Nova Industri AB is now part of SMS group Nordic, with SMS group GmbH in Germany as our parent company. We are a leading service company specializing in industrial production and mechanical engineering, with operations in Boden and Kalix.
For more than 20 years, we have delivered high-quality solutions in turning, milling, welding and steel construction. Our customers are primarily industrial companies in Norrbotten, and our strong local presence is an important part of our success.
About the Role
We are looking for someone with several years of experience in milling, as well as operating and programming 5-axis CNC machines. You are able to produce a finished component based on technical drawings and work instructions, and you have a good understanding of machine operation and programming. At Nova Industri, you will work with advanced machinery in a technology-driven environment.
Your Profile
To be considered for the position, we would like you to have:
Upper-secondary vocational training in an industrial field or equivalent experience.
Several years of experience in milling and working with 5-axis CNC machines.
Experience in offline programming.
A good ability to read and interpret technical drawings and work instructions.
The ability to understand technical documentation.
A strong commitment to maintaining a safe, clean and well-organized work environment.

Experience programming and working with control systems such as Fanuc, Heidenhain, NUM, Siemens and Tebis is an advantage. Experience with CAD/CAM programming and Mastercam is also an advantage. Since our work environment is international, the ability to communicate in English is beneficial. A Category B driving licence and an overhead crane certificate are also advantageous.
As a Person, You Are
Precise and strongly focused on safety and quality.
Self-motivated, able to take initiative and solve problems that arise in your work.
Cooperative and flexible in your approach.

How to Apply
Does this sound like an interesting opportunity? The recruitment process is ongoing so send us your application today.
If you have any questions about the position, please contact HR Manager Maria Taylor at maria.taylor@sms-group.com.
We look forward to receiving your application!

P.S
We will participate on the European Job Days event the 6th of November Swedish Day – Cross-border Sweden / Norway | EURES - European Job Days We hope to meet you there!

jobs.occupation: Lead Embedded & IoT Engineer - TSS
jobs.employer_name: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
jobs.description:
Do you want to take a leading technical role in the development of embedded systems and connected products? At TSS, you will help develop technology used by leading pharmaceutical companies worldwide to monitor temperature-sensitive medicines throughout the supply chain, ensuring they are stored and transported under the right conditions from production to the patient.
About the role
As Lead Embedded & IoT Engineer, you will take a key technical role in the continued development of TSS’s connected products. You will work end-to-end across TSS’s physical and connected products, from electronics, sensors and embedded firmware in the loggers to gateways, cloud integration and TSS applications.
The role combines hands-on engineering with team leadership and technical direction. You will help drive priorities, support the team in technical decisions and collaborate closely with other engineering functions and external partners. This is a senior individual contributor role where you lead through technical expertise and collaboration.
You will, among other things:

Work with electronics, sensors, embedded firmware and connected devices.

Drive technical decisions across hardware, firmware and connectivity.

Contribute to the rollout of a new IoT gateway platform across TSS’s global gateway fleet.

Work with verification, technical troubleshooting, failure analysis, industrialization and taking products into production.

Support other engineers through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.

The role is based at TSS’s office in Solna, with a hybrid setup where the team typically works from the office 2–3 days per week.
About you
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong hands-on background in hardware, electronics and embedded systems, combined with experience from connected products or IoT.
You enjoy staying close to the technology, solving complex technical challenges and taking ownership across technical areas.
We believe you have:

Embedded firmware and hardware/software integration experience.

Experience with sensors, measurement devices or similar physical products.

Experience taking products through verification and into production.

Experience leading technical work, supporting engineering teams or driving complex engineering initiatives.

Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience with BLE, USB, battery-powered products, Linux, IoT gateways, hardware manufacturing, product certification, production testing, calibration or regulated industries is a plus.
Interested?
We review applications continuously, so feel free to apply as soon as possible.
If you have any questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Emil Oskarsson, Talent Acquisition Consultant, at emil.oskarsson@ants.se.
Please note that background checks are conducted as part of our recruitment process.
